hooks.command: bash -c 'PROMPT=$(cat); WARN=""; echo "$PROMPT" | grep -qiE "(story|story #|user story)" && echo "$PROMPT" | grep -qiE "(and also|и также|\band\b.*(\bthen\b)|given.*given)" && WARN="\n⚠️  SD-RULE VIOLATION DETECTED: Story may contain multiple scenarios. Rule SD-1: one story = one Given/When/Then block. Split before creating."; [ -n "$WARN" ] && echo "$WARN" || true'

bash -c 'mkdir -p .claude && echo "## Session Compacted: $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")" >> .claude/session-context.md && echo "Branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo N/A)" >> .claude/session-context.md && echo "Last commits:" >> .claude/session-context.md && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null >> .claude/session-context.md && echo "Uncommitted:" >> .claude/session-context.md && git status --short 2>/dev/null >> .claude/session-context.md && echo "---" >> .claude/session-context.md'

bash -c 'STATUS=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$STATUS" ]; then echo "
⚠️  UNCOMMITTED CHANGES DETECTED:
$STATUS

If this is intentional, ignore. Otherwise commit before finishing."; fi; CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|java|kt|kts|py|html|scss)$" | head -5); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo "
💡 Modified files detected. Consider running /simplify on changed files:
$CHANGED"; fi'
